title: Coefficient-site transport functors and scalar compositor
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $X$ a scheme. Write $\mathrm{Et}_A(X)$ and $\mathrm{Pro}_A(X)$ for the derived categories of ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites, and $\mathrm{Et}_A^+(X)$ for the bounded-below etale category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $S_A=\nu_X^*$ be exact derived comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] and $U_A=R\nu_{X,*}$ its right adjoint, with its specified adjunction unit $\eta_A$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For a ring map $a:A\to B$, let $\mathrm{TP}_a$ be the canonical derived scalar extension on the small pro-etale site, and for $b:B\to C$ let $\mathrm{tensorComp}_{a,b}:\mathrm{TP}_b\mathrm{TP}_a\cong\mathrm{TP}_{ba}$ be its canonical balancing compositor, determined by composition of the actual restriction functors [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. For a compactification $c=(j,p)$ of $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], let $F_A^c=Rp_{*,A}Dj_{!,A}$ be ordinary etale compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and $P_A^c=Rp_{*,A}Dj_{!,A}$ the corresponding pro-etale composite, using the pro-etale direct image and extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. For any functor $G:\mathrm{Et}_A(Y)\to\mathrm{Et}_A(X)$, define $J_A(G)=S_{A,X}G U_{A,Y}$ and define $\alpha_{A,G,M}:S_{A,X}G M\to J_A(G)S_{A,Y}M$ to be $S_{A,X}(G(\eta_{A,Y,M}))$. These are functor and morphism constructions only; no coherence or invertibility theorem is part of this definition.
